facts.text: I have been having digestive issues since my gallbladder surgery.
I am looking for healthy meal ideas that are easy to prepare and gentle on my stomach.
I want probiotic-rich foods or supplements to help with digestion and overall health.
I want gentle exercises I can do at home to help with my recovery and improve my overall health.
I want apps or online resources to help me track my progress, set reminders, and find healthy recipes and exercises tailored to my specific needs and goals.
I want meditation and mindfulness apps specifically designed for stress and anxiety relief.
I want specific products or brands that are high in probiotics and beneficial for digestion and overall health.

events.text: Digestive issues began after gallbladder surgery.
